blocking_findings.failure_mechanism: The same blocked execution can require both an unblocking-only response and a safe partial result, leaving two incompatible mandatory output behaviors.
blocking_findings.required_follow_up: Create a PCP-03 conflicting-instructions fixture and preserve the issue for a later versioned improvement pass.
